_comment: Configuration for the SEPA-VCP screener - INDIA (NSE) edition. Copy to config.json and tweak. config.json is gitignored (user-local); this example is the committed default. ALL strategy settings live here - the Python code reads every threshold from this file. Monetary thresholds are in INR.

universe._comment_caps: INR thresholds. 2000 cr market cap (~USD 240M) and 5 cr/day traded value are sensible liquidity floors for Nifty 500 names.

sepa_trend_template._comment: Minervini's 8-point trend template. DMA periods (50/150/200) are the canonical definition - change only if you know why.

relative_strength._comment: RS percentile inputs. lookback_days are trading days (~3/6/9/12 months); weights must align 1:1 and sum to 1.0.

sepa_fundamentals._comment: provider: yfinance | screener_in | yfinance_then_screener. strict_gate=false means a MISSING fundamental is skipped rather than failing the stock (recommended for India where data is patchy).

scoring._comment: SEPA composite score weights (each block should sum to ~1.0). 'weights' for A/B/C, 'early_weights' for bucket E (no VCP yet), 'fundamental_norm' = growth/ROE value that scores full marks.

market_health._comment: Benchmark health signals shown on the dashboard. distribution_day_pct is the down-day threshold (e.g. -0.002 = -0.2%) on higher volume; fail-rate bands flip the breakout-failure light amber/red.

risk._comment: max_loss_pct caps how far the stop sits below the pivot. Per Minervini, never risk more than ~7-8%.
